<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" />
  <title>CodePortrait Studio — Pro Code Art Editor</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fira+Code:wght@500;700&family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-outer: #04060a;
      --bg-app: #0a0d14;
      --surface-1: #111622;
      --surface-2: #181f30;
      --surface-3: #222b40;
      --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      --border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      --accent: #00d2ff;
      --accent-2: #6366f1;
      --accent-glow: rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.28);
      --text-main: #f8fafc;
      --text-sub: #94a3b8;
      --text-dim: #64748b;
      --danger: #ef4444;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --radius-md: 14px;
      --radius-sm: 10px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    html, body {
      height: 100%;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: var(--bg-outer);
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.09), transparent 40%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 85%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1), transparent 40%);
      color: var(--text-main);
      font-family: 'Inter', 'Hind Siliguri', sans-serif;
    }

    /* App Shell (Mobile-First CapCut Studio Frame) */
    .app-shell {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 580px;
      height: 100dvh;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: var(--bg-app);
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    }

    @media (min-width: 600px) {
      .app-shell {
        border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      }
    }

    /* Screen Management */
    .screen {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--bg-app);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translateY(14px);
      transition: opacity 0.26s ease, transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .screen.active {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
      transform: translateY(0);
      z-index: 5;
    }

    /* Custom Scrollbar */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; height: 5px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 99px; }

    /* ================= HOME VIEW ================= */
    .home-header {
      padding: 16px 20px 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .brand-logo {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d2ff, #6366f1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.3);
    }

    .brand-name {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }

    .pro-pill {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,210,255,0.2), rgba(99,102,241,0.25));
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,210,255,0.35);
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .home-scroll {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 6px 20px 28px;
    }

    /* CapCut Style Hero Create Pic Button */
    .create-pic-btn {
      width: 100%;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 26px 22px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00c6ff 0%, #3b82f6 52%, #6366f1 100%);
      color: #ffffff;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      gap: 10px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(0, 198, 255, 0.24), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }

    .create-pic-btn::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      left: -30%;
      width: 160%;
      height: 160%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(255,255,255,0.22), transparent 55%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .create-pic-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(0, 198, 255, 0.34);
    }

    .create-pic-btn:active {
      transform: scale(0.985);
    }

    .create-plus-circle {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
    }

    .create-pic-title {
      font-size: 21px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .create-pic-sub {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      max-width: 300px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* Quick Feature Strip */
    .feature-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--surface-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 12px 10px;
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--surface-2);
      color: var(--accent);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .feature-label {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .feature-desc {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .section-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-top: 24px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-main);
    }

    .section-action {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    /* Home Preview Grid */
    .home-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .home-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
      border-radius: 14px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--surface-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .home-thumb:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .home-thumb img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }

    .home-thumb-tag {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 6px;
      left: 6px;
      right: 6px;
      background: rgba(6, 9, 15, 0.78);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      padding: 4px 7px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #e2e8f0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    /* ================= GALLERY VIEW ================= */
    .topbar {
      height: 56px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(10, 13, 20, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .icon-btn {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--surface-1);
      color: var(--text-main);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.18s ease;
    }

    .icon-btn:hover {
      background: var(--surface-2);
    }

    .topbar-title {
      font-size: 15.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .gallery-add-pill {
      padding: 7px 13px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      border: none;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
      color: #fff;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--accent-glow);
    }

    .gallery-tabs-bar {
      padding: 12px 16px 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 7px;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .filter-pill {
      padding: 6px 13px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--surface-1);
      color: var(--text-sub);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .filter-pill.active {
      background: rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.14);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .gallery-actions-banner {
      margin: 4px 16px 12px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.08), rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.08));
      border: 1px dashed rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.35);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .banner-text-wrap h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .banner-text-wrap p {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-sub);
    }

    .banner-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .mini-btn {
      padding: 7px 11px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
      background: var(--surface-2);
      color: #fff;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .mini-btn.primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #030712;
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .gallery-grid-wrap {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 0 16px 24px;
    }

    .gallery-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .gallery-tile {
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.15;
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--surface-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease;
    }

    .gallery-tile:hover {
      transform: scale(0.98);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .gallery-tile.add-tile {
      border: 1.5px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
      background: var(--surface-1);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: var(--text-sub);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 8px;
    }

    .gallery-tile.add-tile:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .gallery-tile img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }

    .tile-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 6px;
      left: 6px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .tile-delete {
      position: absolute;
      top: 5px;
      right: 5px;
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: none;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
      color: #f87171;
      font-size: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* ================= EDITOR VIEW (HALF SCREEN PREVIEW + PRO CONTROLS) ================= */
    .editor-topbar {
      height: 52px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: #080b11;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .editor-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-sub);
      background: var(--surface-1);
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .export-top-btn {
      padding: 7px 15px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      border: none;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d2ff, #6366f1);
      color: #fff;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.3);
      transition: transform 0.15s ease;
    }

    .export-top-btn:active {
      transform: scale(0.96);
    }

    /* TOP HALF-SCREEN PREVIEW STAGE */
    .preview-stage {
      height: 46dvh;
      min-height: 250px;
      max-height: 440px;
      background: #030407;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: background-color 0.25s ease;
    }

    .preview-stage.zoom-1x {
      overflow: auto;
      display: block;
      padding: 16px;
    }

    #codeOutput {
      font-family: 'Fira Code', 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 0.86;
      letter-spacing: 0px;
      white-space: pre;
      transform-origin: center center;
      user-select: text;
      transition: text-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }

    .preview-stage.zoom-1x #codeOutput {
      transform: none !important;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: max-content;
    }

    #originalCompareImg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 10px;
      width: calc(100% - 20px);
      height: calc(100% - 20px);
      object-fit: contain;
      display: none;
      z-index: 6;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(3, 4, 7, 0.92);
    }

    .preview-floating-tools {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 10px;
      right: 10px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      z-index: 8;
    }

    .float-tool-btn {
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.78);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      color: #e2e8f0;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .float-tool-btn.active {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.14);
    }

    /* Loader Inside Preview */
    .editor-loader {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(4, 6, 12, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 15;
      padding: 20px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 3px solid rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.15);
      border-top-color: var(--accent);
      border-right-color: var(--accent-2);
      animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    .loader-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .loader-code {
      font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .loader-bar {
      width: 170px;
      height: 4px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      margin-top: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .loader-fill {
      height: 100%;
      width: 0%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
      transition: width 0.25s ease;
    }

    /* BOTTOM EDITOR PANEL */
    .editor-controls-panel {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--bg-app);
      min-height: 0;
    }

    .panel-content {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 14px 18px 16px;
    }

    .tab-pane {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 15px;
    }

    .tab-pane.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* Option Chips */
    .option-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-sub);
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .chips-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .chip-btn {
      padding: 8px 13px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--surface-1);
      color: var(--text-sub);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
    }

    .chip-btn.active {
      background: rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.14);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.14);
    }

    /* Clean Pro Sliders */
    .slider-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .slider-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #cbd5e1;
    }

    .slider-val {
      font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.1);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 100%;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: var(--surface-2);
      outline: none;
    }

    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #fff;
      border: 3px solid var(--accent);
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
    }

    /* Swatches & Toggles */
    .swatch-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .swatch-btn {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
    }

    .swatch-btn.active {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      transform: scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--accent-glow);
    }

    .toggle-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 11px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--surface-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .toggle-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .toggle-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
    .toggle-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); }

    .switch {
      position: relative;
      width: 44px;
      height: 24px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }

    .switch-slider {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--surface-3);
      border-radius: 99px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: 0.25s;
    }

    .switch-slider::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      left: 3px;
      top: 3px;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transition: 0.25s;
    }

    .switch input:checked + .switch-slider {
      background: var(--accent);
    }

    .switch input:checked + .switch-slider::before {
      transform: translateX(20px);
    }

    // ==================== INDEXEDDB GALLERY STORAGE ====================
    const DB_NAME = 'CodePortraitGalleryDB';
    const STORE_NAME = 'photos';
    let db = null;

    function initDB() {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        try {
          if (!window.indexedDB) return resolve([]);
          const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
          req.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
            const database = e.target.result;
            if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
              database.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
            }
          };
          req.onsuccess = (e) => {
            db = e.target.result;
            loadUserPhotosFromDB().then(resolve);
          };
          req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
        } catch (err) {
          resolve([]);
        }
      });
    }

    function loadUserPhotosFromDB() {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (!db) return resolve([]);
        try {
          const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
          const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
          const req = store.getAll();
          req.onsuccess = () => {
            const list = (req.result || []).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
            resolve(list);
          };
          req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
        } catch (e) {
          resolve([]);
        }
      });
    }

    function savePhotoToDB(photoObj) {
      if (!db) return;
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
        tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).put(photoObj);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function deletePhotoFromDB(id) {
      if (!db) return;
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
        tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).delete(id);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ==================== CORE COLOR + CODE ART ENGINE ====================
    function applyPixelColorEffects(r, g, b) {
      // 1. Brightness
      r *= state.brightness;
      g *= state.brightness;
      b *= state.brightness;

      // 2. Contrast
      r = (r - 128) * state.contrast + 128;
      g = (g - 128) * state.contrast + 128;
      b = (b - 128) * state.contrast + 128;

      // 3. Saturation
      const lum = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b;
      r = lum + (r - lum) * state.saturation;
      g = lum + (g - lum) * state.saturation;
      b = lum + (b - lum) * state.saturation;

      // 4. Palette Mode
      if (state.palette === 'matrix') {
        const l = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, lum));
        r = l * 0.16;
        g = Math.min(255, l * 1.25);
        b = l * 0.34;
      } else if (state.palette === 'cyber') {
        const nr = r * 0.92 + b * 0.25;
        const ng = g * 0.84;
        const nb = b * 1.28 + 24;
        r = nr; g = ng; b = nb;
      } else if (state.palette === 'mono') {
        r = lum; g = lum; b = lum;
      }

      return [
        Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(r))),
        Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(g))),
        Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(b)))
      ];
    }

    function renderCodeArt() {
      if (!state.currentImage) return;

      const cols = state.resolution;
      const charStream = codeDictionaries[state.theme];
      const aspectRatio = state.currentImage.height / state.currentImage.width;
      const rows = Math.max(12, Math.round(cols * aspectRatio * 0.56));

      processCanvas.width = cols;
      processCanvas.height = rows;
      pCtx.clearRect(0, 0, cols, rows);
      pCtx.drawImage(state.currentImage, 0, 0, cols, rows);

      const data = pCtx.getImageData(0, 0, cols, rows).data;

      const htmlLines = [];
      state.renderedMatrix = [];
      let charIdx = 0;

      for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
        let lineStr = '';
        const rowTokens = [];

        for (let x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
          const i = (y * cols + x) * 4;
          const a = data[i + 3];
          const ch = charStream[charIdx % charStream.length];
          charIdx++;

          if (a < 28) {
            lineStr += ' ';
            rowTokens.push({ ch: ' ', color: 'transparent' });
            continue;
          }

          const [r, g, b] = applyPixelColorEffects(data[i], data[i + 1], data[i + 2]);
          const safeChar = ch === '<' ? '<' : ch === '>' ? '>' : ch === '&' ? '&' : ch;
          const colorStr = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;

          lineStr += `<span style="color:${colorStr}">${safeChar}</span>`;
          rowTokens.push({ ch, color: colorStr });
        }

        htmlLines.push(lineStr);
        state.renderedMatrix.push(rowTokens);
      }

      const finalInnerHtml = htmlLines.join('\n');
      codeOutput.innerHTML = finalInnerHtml;
      applyCodeVisualStyles();

      editorStats.textContent = `${cols}×${rows} (${(cols * rows).toLocaleString()})`;

      // Build standalone exportable HTML
      state.generatedFullHtml = `<!DOCTYPE html>

    font-family: 'Fira Code', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-weight: ${state.bold ? '700' : '500'};
    font-size: ${state.fontSize}px;
    line-height: 0.86;
    letter-spacing: 0px;
    margin: 0;
    ${state.glow ? 'text-shadow: 0 0 6px currentColor;' : ''}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<pre>${finalInnerHtml}</pre>
</body>
</html>`;

      requestAnimationFrame(autoFitPreview);
    }

    function applyCodeVisualStyles() {
      previewStage.style.backgroundColor = state.bgColor;
      codeOutput.style.fontSize = `${state.fontSize}px`;
      codeOutput.style.fontWeight = state.bold ? '700' : '500';
      codeOutput.style.textShadow = state.glow ? '0 0 6px currentColor' : 'none';
    }

    function autoFitPreview() {
      if (state.zoom1x) {
        codeOutput.style.transform = 'none';
        return;
      }
      codeOutput.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
      const natW = codeOutput.offsetWidth;
      const natH = codeOutput.offsetHeight;
      if (!natW || !natH) return;

      const availW = previewStage.clientWidth - 24;
      const availH = previewStage.clientHeight - 24;
      const scale = Math.min(availW / natW, availH / natH, 2.2);
      codeOutput.style.transform = `scale(${scale.toFixed(4)})`;
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (editorView.classList.contains('active')) {
        autoFitPreview();
      }
    });

    // Debounced live render for smooth sliders
    let renderDebounce = null;
    function scheduleRender() {
      clearTimeout(renderDebounce);
      renderDebounce = setTimeout(() => {
        renderCodeArt();
      }, 55);
    }

    // ==================== EDITOR CONTROLS ====================
    // Bottom Navigation Tabs
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(tabBtn => {
      tabBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        tabBtn.classList.add('active');
        document.getElementById(tabBtn.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // Zoom & Compare Floating Tools
    zoomToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.zoom1x = !state.zoom1x;
      previewStage.classList.toggle('zoom-1x', state.zoom1x);
      zoomToggleBtn.classList.toggle('active', state.zoom1x);
      zoomLabel.textContent = state.zoom1x ? '1:1 জুম' : 'Fit';
      autoFitPreview();
    });

    compareBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const showing = originalCompareImg.style.display === 'block';
      originalCompareImg.style.display = showing ? 'none' : 'block';
      compareBtn.classList.toggle('active', !showing);
    });

    // Code Language Chips
    document.querySelectorAll('#codeThemeChips .chip-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('#codeThemeChips .chip-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        state.theme = btn.dataset.theme;
        renderCodeArt();
      });
    });

    // Palette Chips
    document.querySelectorAll('#paletteChips .chip-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('#paletteChips .chip-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        state.palette = btn.dataset.palette;
        renderCodeArt();
      });
    });

    // Sliders
    resolutionRange.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.resolution = parseInt(resolutionRange.value, 10);
      resVal.textContent = `${state.resolution} cols`;
      scheduleRender();
    });

    fontSizeRange.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.fontSize = parseInt(fontSizeRange.value, 10);
      sizeVal.textContent = `${state.fontSize}px`;
      applyCodeVisualStyles();
      requestAnimationFrame(autoFitPreview);
    });

    brightnessRange.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.brightness = parseFloat(brightnessRange.value);
      brightVal.textContent = `${state.brightness.toFixed(2)}x`;
      scheduleRender();
    });

    contrastRange.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.contrast = parseFloat(contrastRange.value);
      contrastVal.textContent = `${state.contrast.toFixed(2)}x`;
      scheduleRender();
    });

    saturationRange.addEventListener('input', () => {
      state.saturation = parseFloat(saturationRange.value);
      satVal.textContent = `${state.saturation.toFixed(2)}x`;
      scheduleRender();
    });

    document.getElementById('resetColorBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.palette = 'original';
      state.brightness = 1.15;
      state.contrast = 1.08;
      state.saturation = 1.15;

      brightnessRange.value = 1.15;
      contrastRange.value = 1.08;
      saturationRange.value = 1.15;
      brightVal.textContent = '1.15x';
      contrastVal.textContent = '1.08x';
      satVal.textContent = '1.15x';

      document.querySelectorAll('#paletteChips .chip-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.palette === 'original');
      });
      renderCodeArt();
      showToast('কালার সেটিংস রিসেট হয়েছে');
    });

    // Background Swatches & Toggles
    document.querySelectorAll('#bgSwatches .swatch-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('#bgSwatches .swatch-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        state.bgColor = btn.dataset.bg;
        applyCodeVisualStyles();
      });
    });

    glowToggle.addEventListener('change', () => {
      state.glow = glowToggle.checked;
      applyCodeVisualStyles();
    });

    boldToggle.addEventListener('change', () => {
      state.bold = boldToggle.checked;
      applyCodeVisualStyles();
      requestAnimationFrame(autoFitPreview);
    });

    // ==================== EXPORT FUNCTIONS ====================
    function exportPng(scaleMult = 1) {
      if (!state.renderedMatrix.length) return;
      showToast(scaleMult > 1 ? '4K ছবি তৈরি হচ্ছে...' : 'HD PNG সেভ হচ্ছে...');

      setTimeout(() => {
        const exportCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        const eCtx = exportCanvas.getContext('2d');

        const fontSize = 14 * scaleMult;
        const charWidth = fontSize * 0.62;
        const lineHeight = fontSize * 0.88;
        const pad = 24 * scaleMult;

        const rows = state.renderedMatrix.length;
        const cols = state.renderedMatrix[0].length;

        exportCanvas.width = Math.ceil(cols * charWidth + pad * 2);
        exportCanvas.height = Math.ceil(rows * lineHeight + pad * 2);

        eCtx.fillStyle = state.bgColor;
        eCtx.fillRect(0, 0, exportCanvas.width, exportCanvas.height);

        eCtx.font = `${state.bold ? 'bold' : '500'} ${fontSize}px "Fira Code", "Courier New", monospace`;
        eCtx.textBaseline = 'top';

        for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
          for (let x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
            const token = state.renderedMatrix[y][x];
            if (token.ch === ' ') continue;
            eCtx.fillStyle = token.color;
            if (state.glow) {
              eCtx.shadowBlur = 5 * scaleMult;
              eCtx.shadowColor = token.color;
            }
            eCtx.fillText(token.ch, pad + x * charWidth, pad + y * lineHeight);
          }
        }

        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.download = scaleMult > 1 ? 'code-portrait-4k.png' : 'code-portrait-hd.png';
        link.href = exportCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        link.click();
        exportModal.classList.remove('open');
        showToast('PNG ছবি ডাউনলোড সম্পন্ন!');
      }, 40);
    }

    function exportHtmlFile() {
      if (!state.generatedFullHtml) return;
      const blob = new Blob([state.generatedFullHtml], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'code-portrait.html';
      link.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      exportModal.classList.remove('open');
      showToast('HTML ফাইল ডাউনলোড হয়েছে!');
    }

    async function copyHtmlSource() {
      if (!state.generatedFullHtml) return;
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(state.generatedFullHtml);
        exportModal.classList.remove('open');
        showToast('সম্পূর্ণ HTML কোড কপি হয়েছে!');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('কপি করা যায়নি, ডাউনলোড বাটন ব্যবহার করুন');
      }
    }

    // Bind Export Buttons (both Quick Export tab & Top Modal)
    openExportModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportModal.classList.add('open'));
    closeExportModalBtn.addEventListener('click', () => exportModal.classList.remove('open'));
    exportModal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === exportModal) exportModal.classList.remove('open');
    });

    document.getElementById('quickPngHdBtn').addEventListener('click', () => exportPng(1));
    document.getElementById('modalPngHdBtn').addEventListener('click', () => exportPng(1));

    document.getElementById('quickPng4kBtn').addEventListener('click', () => exportPng(2));
    document.getElementById('modalPng4kBtn').addEventListener('click', () => exportPng(2));

    document.getElementById('quickHtmlBtn').addEventListener('click', exportHtmlFile);
    document.getElementById('modalHtmlBtn').addEventListener('click', exportHtmlFile);

    document.getElementById('quickCopyBtn').addEventListener('click', copyHtmlSource);
    document.getElementById('modalCopyBtn').addEventListener('click', copyHtmlSource);

    // ==================== INIT APP ====================
    (async function bootstrap() {
      state.samplePhotos = generateStarterSamples();
      state.userPhotos = await initDB();
      renderAllGrids();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
